name: fgvc_aircraft
description: FGVC-Aircraft is a fine-grained visual classification dataset of aircraft images labeled by model and variant. It measures a model's ability to distinguish very similar object classes (aircraft variants) under varying viewpoints and imaging conditions, making it a standard benchmark for fine-grained recognition and transfer learning research.
reputation: Well-known and widely used benchmark in the fine-grained visual classification (FGVC) community since its introduction.
